newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at $65, off $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at $65, off $1 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt lower than last week.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 2,000 slaughter steers and 2,700 heifers; 42,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 31,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00.
Wk to date - 42,700 Week Ago - 76,100 Year Ago - 117,500
